name: make_v7
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
s=open("source/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.roff",encoding="utf-8").read()
reps=[
(".br
.sp 0.5v
.ne 5v
.ft B
.ps 13
References",
 ".br
.sp 0.3v
.ne 5v
.ft B
.ps 13
References"),
(".sp 0.5v
.sp 0.3v
[1] Lawrence Hollom",
 ".sp 0.3v
.sp 0.2v
[1] Lawrence Hollom"),
(".br
.sp 0.3v
[2] Tomasz",
 ".br
.sp 0.2v
[2] Tomasz"),
(".br
.sp 0.3v
[3] Peter",
 ".br
.sp 0.2v
[3] Peter"),
(".sp 0.5v
.sp 0.3v
The prior-art search",
 ".sp 0.3v
.sp 0.3v
The prior-art search"),
]
for a,b in reps:
    assert s.count(a)==1, a[:50]
    s=s.replace(a,b)
open("qa/tmp/v7.roff","w",encoding="utf-8").write(s)
print("ok")
